transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because, for the last few weeks, I just haven’t had much of an appetite. Even stuff I normally like after a shift, I’ll get it and it just kind of sits there. I end up forcing down a few bites and that’s about it.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?
Yeah… most days, I’d say. It’s like I’m carrying this heavy, flat feeling around all day. Even when I’m at home with my family or just sitting in the break room, I don’t really feel present.
Have you noticed that you don’t take pleasure in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or time with family?

Yeah, I have. I used to look forward to my morning runs, playing guitar, cooking dinner… things like that. Lately I just keep skipping them. They feel more like chores than anything I actually want to do.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking energy most days, even when you haven’t been doing much physically?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I do feel kind of worn out sometimes, but I haven’t paid close attention to whether it’s most days or if it’s unusual. It’s hard to tell with work and everything.
Would you say that most days, you feel down or depressed for most of the day, like it's a constant feeling?
Yeah. Most days it’s there for a lot of the day. It’s not always intense, but it’s this heavy, flat feeling, like I’m around people or at home and I’m just not really there.
Have you been having trouble sleeping, like staying up late because you can’t fall asleep, or do you find yourself sleeping much more than usual even when you don’t feel tired?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed a big change either way. Some nights I’m up later than I’d like, but I don’t know if it’s more than normal, and I’m not sleeping all day or anything.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough or have been blaming yourself for things more than usual?

I don’t really know. I mean, I get frustrated with myself sometimes, but I haven’t noticed that I’m blaming myself a lot more than usual or feeling worthless exactly. It’s not something I’ve really been keeping track of.
Have you noticed any significant weight loss recently, or a decrease in appetite nearly every day?

Yeah, my appetite’s been pretty low the last few weeks. I’ll get food after a shift, even stuff I usually like, and it just kind of sits there. I have to make myself take a few bites. I haven’t really been tracking my weight, though.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or have trouble sitting still and feel restless?

Yeah… I think more slow than restless. At work, people have noticed it during briefings. I’m moving slower, and when someone asks me something, it takes me longer to answer. It feels like my body and my mouth are both kind of a step behind everybody else.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself or that life isn’t worth living?

I’m not making any plans to hurt myself or anything like that. But… yeah, I do get thoughts sometimes like maybe it wouldn’t be so bad if I just didn’t wake up, and I didn’t have to keep pushing through this.
Can you describe how your mood has been lately—specifically, would you say that you feel depressed most of the time, and that you’ve lost pleasure in almost everything you do?

Yeah… most days I feel pretty down. It’s like I’m carrying around this heavy, flat feeling, even when I’m at home with my family or sitting in the break room. I’m there, but I don’t really feel there, if that makes sense. Stuff I normally would enjoy just doesn’t feel like much right now.

Can you tell me if there have been specific times at work or at home where this low mood or lack of interest in things has really interfered with what you need to get done, like at work, with your family, or in other important areas of your life?

Yeah. I mean, I’m still going in and doing the basic parts of the job, but it’s not like it was. I’ve made mistakes in the paperwork, and there was one time I missed something on the surveillance that I should’ve caught. I ended up getting a formal warning, which… that’s never really happened to me before. So it’s starting to affect my work, even if I’m still showing up.
Have you experienced this low mood or lack of interest in things for most of the day, more days than not, for at least the past two years?
No, not for two years. It’s been more like about three weeks now, since they reorganized the security operations at the casino and changed my assignments. Since then it’s been most days.

latest_inference.note: The patient's symptoms have been present for about three weeks, not two years, ruling out F33.x (recurrent depressive disorder). The severity includes marked loss of interest, significant functional impairment at work, and psychomotor slowing, which aligns with moderate (F32.1) or severe (F32.2) depressive episode. However, the presence of psychomotor slowing and suicidal ideation without a history of manic or hypomanic episodes, and without psychotic features, makes F32.2 (Severe depressive episode) the most accurate diagnosis. F32.3 is ruled out due to absence of psychotic features. F32.1 was downgraded to F32.2 due to severity of symptoms and impairment.
